benchmark_isolation: Release defaults and the manually specified inventory were frozen before the independent test manifest was evaluated. Inventory development could use public PACO train/development taxonomy and the old development cases; this is disclosed rather than treated as zero-shot taxonomy discovery. Independent-test part labels and masks are never read by inference and are opened only for scoring.
parameter_origin_note: Values are hand-engineered release constants or manual inventory rules, not estimates fitted on the independent test labels.
